title: •Dark Forces
caption: •Dark Forces (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Once per turn, if opponent just drew weapon destiny targeting your Dark Jedi, may lose 1 Force to cancel and redraw that destiny. Once per game, may exchange a card in opponent’s Lost Pile with a card on their Colo Claw Fish. {alter}
lore: “The ability to destroy a planet is insignificant next to the power of the Force.”

notes: Unique (dot). Only a 350 px scan exists (Jedi-D-darkforces.gif); copyright year read as 1996 at that size (matches the Jedi Pack Tarkin reference). Lore on the wiki is the quoted sentence in straight single quotes; the printed card's quote style could not be verified at 350 px. Immunity icons on the slip (letter in a red circle with a red slash) tokened as {alter}/{control}/{sense} per caller's convention (other helpers' files use {icon:immune-alter} style). No modern 'Virtual Set N' remake exists; the wiki's only (V) page is a Virtual Block 1 preview composite (VB1-D-darkforces-pre.gif) which is just the Original slip laid over the 350 px scan — downloaded to src/vs3/modern/ for reference but modern=null.
